title: Reindexing preserves inverse-image transition coherence
statement: Let $I$ and $J$ be preordered sets, $t:J\to I$ a functor, and $D:I^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{Sch}$ a scheme diagram [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Let $F_i$ be abelian etale sheaves on $D_i$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] with inverse-image transition maps $\varphi_f:D(f^{\mathrm{op}})^{-1}F_i\to F_j$ satisfying the canonical identity and composition laws [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Set $D^{\prime}=t^{\mathrm{op}}\mathbin{\circ}D$, $F^{\prime}_j=F_{t(j)}$, and $\varphi^{\prime}_f=\varphi_{t(f)}$. Then $\varphi^{\prime}$ satisfies the canonical inverse-image identity and composition laws for $D^{\prime}$. No nonemptiness, directedness, affineness or limit is assumed.

proof.text: Apply the proved private transport lemma for an abstract contravariant functor P with arbitrary identity and composition maps. In that lemma, specialize hidentity at t.obj i and hcomposition at t.map f and t.map g. Morphisms in a preorder are lifts of propositions, so the mapped identity and composite agree definitionally with the corresponding identity and composite; proof irrelevance identifies all equality witnesses. Specialize P and its maps to upperStar, upperStarId.hom.app and upperStarComp.hom.app. Pass all dependent arguments explicitly to avoid costly conversion through eta expansions. No new mathematical assumptions or unproved lemmas are used.

theorem etale_limit_reindex_transition_coherence
    {I J : Type u} [Preorder I] [Preorder J]
    (t : J ⥤ I) (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u})
    (F : ∀ i : I, Sheaf (D.obj (op i)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (φ : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j),
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map f.op)).obj (F i) ⟶ F j)
    (hidentity : ∀ i : I, φ (𝟙 i) =
      (eqToIso (congrArg (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (D.map_id (op i)))).hom.app
        (F i) ≫ (upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.obj (op i))).hom.app (F i))
    (hcomposition : ∀ (i j k : I) (f : i ⟶ j) (g : j ⟶ k),
      φ (f ≫ g) =
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op) (D.map f.op)
          (D.map (f ≫ g).op) (D.map_comp g.op f.op)).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op)).map (φ f) ≫ φ g)
    :
    let D' := t.op ⋙ D
    let F' (i : J) := F (t.obj i)
    let φ' {i j : J} (f : i ⟶ j) := φ (t.map f)
    ((∀ i : J, φ' (𝟙 i) =
      (eqToIso (congrArg (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (D'.map_id (op i)))).hom.app
        (F' i) ≫ (upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D'.obj (op i))).hom.app (F' i)) ∧
    (∀ (i j k : J) (f : i ⟶ j) (g : j ⟶ k),
      φ' (f ≫ g) =
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D'.map g.op) (D'.map f.op)
          (D'.map (f ≫ g).op) (D'.map_comp g.op f.op)).hom.app (F' i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D'.map g.op)).map (φ' f) ≫ φ' g))
